parameters.name: time_field
parameters.description: Time axis to filter and order by. `created_at` / `updated_at` = ingest and last-write time; `mentioned_at` / `occurred_start` / `occurred_end` = event time. Defaults to `created_at` when only `start_date`/`end_date` are given. Filtering and ordering both follow `time_field`, and rows with no value on that column are excluded — so `total` counts only rows carrying that timestamp, and can be 0 on a bank that is not empty.
